title: Dump index
description: index.json at the root of the dump and of the API's static mirror. It lists which area files exist, so a client can fetch one document instead of probing for files that are not there. Counts are a convenience for humans: a client must not assume an area is empty because a count says zero.

generated.description: Date of the export that wrote this file, or null when nothing has been published yet.

areas.description: One entry per geohash-5 area that has a file. The key is the area, and the path of its file follows the rule in docs/geohash.md.

updated.description: Date this area file last changed. Optional, so a client must not require it.
